notes.title: Snow Cone Serenade is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome, outsider![/h1]

Snow Cone Serenade is available to play free, starting [b]right now[/b]! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2784660/Snow_Cone_Serenade/][img]https://i.imgur.com/LhwEGd0.gif[/img][/url]

I hope, you'll have a fun little ride. Thank you for playing, supporting and making this little adventure what it is!

How about we hang out? You can find my stories about game development, as well as news about my projects on my Website [url=https://midipotion.super.site/]midipotion.super.site[/url].

We can also hang out on [url=https://twitter.com/PotionOfMidi]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.instagram.com/potionofmidi/]Instagram[/url]. Tell me what you think!

Also, the full Soundtrack to Snow Cone Serenade is Out Now on [url=https://midipotion.bandcamp.com/album/snow-cone-serenade]Bandcamp[/url]! Enjoy those bleeps & bloops with a hot beverage of your choice! 

Dive in with style!

notes.title: We have been included in Arcweaves Top Indie Games to Wishlist in 2024!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tnOCLqb.jpg[/img]
[h1]Outsiders, welcome!
[/h1]
The fine folks over at Arcweave included Snow Cone Serenade 
in their [url=https://blog.arcweave.com/indie-story-games-to-wishlist-in-2024]Top Indie Games to Wishlist in 2024[/url]! 

[i]"Despite being only an hour long, Snow Cone Serenade makes every second count through meticulously crafted character interactions which, while brief, have notable growth and development that is profoundly impactful."[/i]

Makes my heart melt, thank you Arcweave! :)

Stay tuned for the full release, which will happen in March! I can't wait to share it with you, so stay tuned!

All the best,
Midi
